title: Ajal se Bachane Ko
body:
ajal se bachane ko aansu bahaye
magar maa ki godhi may asghar na aaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye himmat thi asghar ki dunya pa jaye
hasi aa gayi aur aansu na aaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo saahil par abbas bharte hai pani
magar behti maujon se daaman bachaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
chale aao asghar tadapti hai maadar
akela hai jhoola kahan tak jhulaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
na asghar may dam hai na raazi hai maula
ye kya dekhte hai nigahein jhukaye
ajal se bachane ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
ajal poochti hai shah e deen se ran may
kise laa rahe hai aba may chupaye
ajal se bachane ko...
author: Mahir Lakhnavi
